sing.speaker: choir
sing.text: You. The one with the Beacon. We drowned for a very long time and we have been practising your name. Come down. We are invited, and so are you.

choices.text: [Choir-touched] You have practised my name since I was born. I know the tune.
[Skyborn] The orbital archive says the Sundering was a flood. You are saying otherwise.
Kaj-7, is this what you hear?

who.speaker: choir
who.text: Your makers. They chose the flood over us. They were wrong, and the flood agreed with them. Ask the one who sealed the vaults. Ask the shield who burned the stair. Everyone here was chosen.

chosen.speaker: choir
chosen.text: Your makers were offered us. Every voice kept, every death undone, the whole world one chord, in exchange for the doors. They said no. The no was the flood. They called it the Sundering afterwards so that nobody would ask who chose it. Somebody always chooses.

choices.text: Then the Sundering was a choice. Up. All of us.

cinder_yes.speaker: cinder
cinder_yes.text: I was there. I said yes, and it kept me, and I have had four hundred years to wonder whether the ones who said no were the wise ones. I still do not know. Ask me again when we find a Key.

choices.text: I will. Up. All of us.

kaj.speaker: kaj7
kaj.text: Yes. But it is not calling me now. It is calling you. I would like us to go up.
